concerns.text: The plan aggregates published one‑sided upper limits by simply converting to 90 % CL and selecting the minimum per nucleus, then applies leave‑one‑out, bootstrap, and a 10 000‑shuffle permutation test on these minima. Treating upper limits as deterministic point estimates and permuting study labels does not constitute a statistically valid meta‑analysis; the permutation test is ill‑defined for already‑bounded quantities and the minimum‑limit rule ignores the information contained in the reported uncertainties and confidence levels.
